chunks: Many a habitation have We laid low before: Our retribution came upon them in the night or in the midst of siesta at noon.
ai.seo_question: How did divine punishment come upon previous communities according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the suddenness of divine retribution, illustrating how Allah's punishment (bās) can strike while communities are either asleep or engaged in their midday siesta (qā'ilūn), catching them off guard. It serves as a reminder of the unpredictability of death and the Day of Judgment, urging believers to maintain constant spiritual vigilance regardless of their daily activities.
